description: Raw historical business observations for student model development. This dataset is intentionally not cleaned, filtered, feature-engineered, labeled, or split for machine learning.
purpose: Raw weekly volatile-demand evidence. Students must normalize identifiers, handle missing/corrected observations, investigate outliers and construct leakage-safe rolling examples.

expected_issues: planner notes from mixed source systems

analysis_expectations: Which observations are unavailable at prediction time?
Which anomalies are plausible demand shocks versus data defects?
How reliable are confirmed orders at different horizons?
Does recent behavior differ from older history?
student_warning: Do not modify the raw evidence or treat every anomaly as an error. Create derived supervised datasets and document cleaning/label assumptions.
